v1 reached end of life on 2026-08-01 alongside the webhooks GA changelog entry. This guide covers the three breaking changes you need to handle to move a v1 integration to v2.

1. Pagination: offset → cursor

v1 used page/per_page query parameters. v2 uses an opaque cursor and next_cursor — see Rate limits & errors for the exact envelope.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v1/pipelines?page=2&per_page=20 + GET /v2/pipelines?cursor=eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ}}

2. Status checks: polling → webhooks

v1 had no push notifications — you polled a pipeline's status endpoint. v2 replaces this with the Webhooks endpoint: subscribe to pipeline.completed and pipeline.failed instead of polling.

3. Error shape

v1 returned bare error strings. v2 wraps every error in an object with a stable code field. Update any error handling that matched on message text — see the error shape reference.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=v1 is retired|body_html=

v1 endpoints no longer accept requests. If you're seeing 404s on /v1/* paths, that's why — there is no grace-period fallback.

}}

input.body:
Events endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=primary}}

Query and replay events that have flowed through a pipeline with enhanced filtering, better error handling, and improved pagination.

List events

GET /v3/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events — cursor-paginated, filterable by type, status, and occurred_at range.

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=typestringNoFilter to a single event type, e.g. order.created.statusstringNoFilter by event status: processed, failed, or dead_lettered.sincestringNoISO-8601 timestamp lower bound on occurred_at.untilstringNoISO-8601 timestamp upper bound on occurred_at.cursorstringNoOpaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.limitintegerNoMaximum results per page (1–100, default 20).}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=event.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "type": "order.created", "status": "processed", "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:44Z", "processed_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:45Z", "payload": { "order_id": "ord_4471" }, "metadata": { "retry_count": 0, "source": "webhook" } }}}

Replay a dead-lettered event

POST /v3/events/{id}/replay — re-runs an event that exhausted its retries. The response includes the new attempt ID and status. Replay operations are tracked in event history.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=replay-response.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "status": "processing", "attempt_id": "att_9d3e2b11", "replayed_at": "2026-08-20T14:35:22Z" }}}

Get event status

GET /v3/events/{id} — retrieve the full history, status, and retry information for a specific event.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=event-detail.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "type": "order.created", "status": "processed", "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:44Z", "processed_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:45Z", "payload": { "order_id": "ord_4471" }, "attempts": [ { "id": "att_8f2c1a90", "status": "success", "timestamp": "2026-08-18T09:12:45Z", "duration_ms": 142 } ] }}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Platform events|body_html=

Lifecycle notifications like pipeline.started and connector.error are not returned by this endpoint — subscribe to them through the Webhooks endpoint instead.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=

  • Replay a dead-lettered event
  • Get event status

Events endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2 retired|variant=danger}}

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=v2 is no longer supported|body_html=

The v2 events endpoint is no longer accepting requests. Migrate to v3 immediately — it provides better filtering, event status tracking, and improved error handling.

See the migration guide below for upgrade details.

}}

Migrate from v2 to v3

Base path change

Update your endpoint paths from /v2/ to /v3/:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events + GET /v3/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events - POST /v2/events/{id}/replay + POST /v3/events/{id}/replay}}

New filters and response fields

v3 adds status and until query parameters for more precise filtering. Response objects now include:

  • status: processed, failed, or dead_lettered
  • processed_at: timestamp when the event completed processing
  • metadata: object containing retry_count and source
  • attempts: full retry history (available via GET /v3/events/{id})
{{ds:component/code-block|filename=v2-response.json|language=json|code=// v2 response (deprecated) { "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "type": "order.created", "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:44Z", "payload": { "order_id": "ord_4471" } }}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=v3-response.json|language=json|code=// v3 response (current) { "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "type": "order.created", "status": "processed", "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:44Z", "processed_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:45Z", "payload": { "order_id": "ord_4471" }, "metadata": { "retry_count": 0, "source": "webhook" } }}}

Replay operation improvements

The replay endpoint now returns an attempt_id and tracks the replay in event history. No functional change to the request — just enhanced responses.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Need help?|body_html=

Common migration issues are covered in Troubleshooting / FAQ. For detailed v3 documentation, see the v3 Events endpoint reference.

}}

input.short_description: Move an existing v2 integration to the v3 API: new status field, improved filtering, and event history tracking.
input.body:
Migration guide (v2 → v3) {{ds:component/chip|label=v2 retired|variant=danger}}

v2 reached end of life on 2026-08-20. This guide covers the changes you need to make to move a v2 integration to v3. The upgrade is straightforward — most code changes are optional as v3 is backwards-compatible in spirit, with additive enhancements.

1. Update endpoint paths

Change all references from /v2/ to /v3/:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events + GET /v3/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events - GET /v2/events/{id}/replay + GET /v3/events/{id}/replay}}

2. Handle new response fields (recommended)

v3 event responses include additional fields that provide better visibility into event processing:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=event-v3.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "type": "order.created", "status": "processed", // NEW: processing status "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:44Z", "processed_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:45Z", // NEW: completion timestamp "payload": { "order_id": "ord_4471" }, "metadata": { // NEW: retry and source info "retry_count": 0, "source": "webhook" } }}}

Your existing code will continue to work — these fields are safe to ignore. However, we recommend updating error handling to check the status field:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=usage.js|language=javascript|code=// Before: no status visibility const events = await api.getEvents(pipelineId); // After: check status explicitly const events = await api.getEvents(pipelineId); events.forEach(event => { if (event.status === 'dead_lettered') { console.log(`Dead-lettered event: ${event.id}`); // Decide whether to replay or investigate } });}}

3. Leverage new filtering options

v3 introduces status and until query parameters for more targeted queries:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=filtering.sh|language=bash|code=# Get only failed events in a time range curl "https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines/pipe_abc/events?status=failed&since=2026-08-20T00:00:00Z&until=2026-08-21T00:00:00Z" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" # Get paginated results with custom page size curl "https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines/pipe_abc/events?limit=50&cursor=eyJvZmZzZXQiOjUwfQ" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY"}}

4. Use the new event details endpoint

v3 adds a new endpoint to fetch full event history including all retry attempts:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=event-details.sh|language=bash|code=# Get full event with all attempts curl "https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/events/evt_8f2c1a90" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" # Returns: # { # "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", # "type": "order.created", # "status": "processed", # "attempts": [ # { "id": "att_abc123", "status": "success", "timestamp": "..." } # ] # } }}

5. Enhanced replay responses

When replaying dead-lettered events, v3 now returns the new attempt ID and immediate status:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=replay-v3.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "status": "processing", // NEW: immediate status "attempt_id": "att_9d3e2b11", // NEW: track the replay attempt "replayed_at": "2026-08-20T14:35:22Z" }}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Timeline|body_html=

v2 is no longer available. If you see 404 errors on /v2/events/*, migrate to v3 immediately — there is no grace period. See the changelog for the exact retirement date.

}}

Still stuck?

Common migration issues are covered in Troubleshooting / FAQ. For full v3 API documentation, see the Events endpoint reference.

Migrate from v2 to v3

Base path change

Update your endpoint paths from /v2/ to /v3/:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events\n+ GET /v3/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events\n\n- POST /v2/events/{id}/replay\n+ POST /v3/events/{id}/replay}}

New filters and response fields

v3 adds status and until query parameters for more precise filtering. Response objects now include:

  • status: processed, failed, or dead_lettered
  • processed_at: timestamp when the event completed processing
  • metadata: object containing retry_count and source
  • attempts: full retry history (available via GET /v3/events/{id})
{{ds:component/code-block|filename=v2-response.json|language=json|code=// v2 response (deprecated)\n{\n \"id\": \"evt_8f2c1a90\",\n \"type\": \"order.created\",\n \"occurred_at\": \"2026-08-18T09:12:44Z\",\n \"payload\": { \"order_id\": \"ord_4471\" }\n}}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=v3-response.json|language=json|code=// v3 response (current)\n{\n \"id\": \"evt_8f2c1a90\",\n \"type\": \"order.created\",\n \"status\": \"processed\",\n \"occurred_at\": \"2026-08-18T09:12:44Z\",\n \"processed_at\": \"2026-08-18T09:12:45Z\",\n \"payload\": { \"order_id\": \"ord_4471\" },\n \"metadata\": {\n \"retry_count\": 0,\n \"source\": \"webhook\"\n }\n}}}

Replay operation improvements

The replay endpoint now returns an attempt_id and tracks the replay in event history. No functional change to the request — just enhanced responses.
